title: Certified nonlinear corrections supply a noisy observation channel with nested cost and a hard node cap
reported_status: Preserved producer claims and separate internally derived results. Source claims, internally derived proofs and same-team criticism remain unreviewed externally. Historical novelty, external mathematical correctness and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Exact algebra, producer replay, source hashes and validators establish only their specified scope. scientific_scope_status: Supplied nonlinear forward model, evaluable predictor, globally certified enclosure and coefficient bounds, fresh exact diffusion/branching primitives and full acquisition cost. A fixed finite observation list gives iid whole correction vectors with |E_i|<=h_i and mean u_i-v_i. The target is a declared positive-noise Gaussian joint law, not a noise-free solution or unknown physical uncertainty distribution. Exact-real theorem, node ceiling, finite-bit law certification and physical model validation are separate.
